Sam (release-ops): deploybot flagged a p95 latency spike on /v2/generate at ~15:04 UTC. It recommends partial-unpin to v2.3.3 (10%) or full rollback to v2.3.2. Traces show some 30s tails and intermittent 502s.
deploybot: Recommendation -> staggered-unpin v2.3.3 @10% OR rollback to v2.3.2. Trigger: p95>1.2s for 3 windows.
Mika (infra): KV miss rate rose ~10% at the same time. I can toggle read-through routing on 20% hosts (3m).
Lee (oncall): +1 partial 10% -> observe 5m -> ramp if stable, else full rollback. Who will execute?
Sam (release-ops): I'll run it. Command: `/deploy unpin --service inference --from v2.4.0 --to v2.3.3 --pct 10 --strategy staggered --reason "p95 spike"`
deploybot: Acknowledged. Initiating staggered-unpin 10% to v2.3.3. Reporting step status.
Jordan (sre): Early signal after slice change: p95 down ~20% on the unpinned slice, overall 502s down to ~0.9%.
Carmen (prod-comm): Drafting customer blurb: "We observed degraded generation latency; a temporary traffic rollback is in progress to restore performance." Will send after decision final.
Priya (pm): If root cause != KV routing, assign postmortem owners.
Sam (release-ops): TL;DR: partial unpin done, metrics improving. Will continue to ramp if stable. Opening ticket INC-2040 for follow-up.
